intuition.title: Mg feed controls hierarchical morphology
intuition.text: At fixed 20 mM CaCl2, the source reports regular rhombohedra without Mg, elongated rhombohedra at 10–20 mM Mg2+, dumbbells at 40 mM, and stacked spheres over 50–60 mM. The 60 mM images illustrate the latter range; no separately labelled 50 mM batch is invented. At 100 mM, the identified deposit is amorphous calcium carbonate with a smooth planar surface.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 2–3, Figures 1, 3–4 and morphology discussion

intuition.title: Three structural scales must remain distinct
intuition.text: Macroscopic architectures comprise triangular submicron units, described as several hundred nanometers wide, which contain nanocrystals. At 20 mM, SEM describes nanocrystals smaller than 50 nm and HRTEM resolves 5–20 nm mosaic domains. At 40/60 mM, surface crystallites are reported smaller than 20 nm; the 40 mM fractured radial interior separately contains 20–30 nm crystallites. These observations are not a single averaged particle size.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 2–3, Figures 4–6 and size descriptions

intuition.title: Mg substitution and excess amorphous material
intuition.text: The (104) calcite peak shifts to higher angle and broadens with Mg feed. Substitution inferred from lattice contraction is lower than total Mg measured by ion chromatography, suggesting Mg outside the crystal lattice. The abstract states ca. 6% maximum substitution; exact per-feed values are only graphed and are not digitized here. The authors propose that excess Mg stabilizes ACC, suppressing regular growth and producing connected nanocrystals; this is a mechanistic interpretation, not a measured growth rate.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 1–4, Abstract, Figure 2 and mechanism

intuition.title: SI calibration versus product evidence
intuition.text: SI Figure S1 plots reference lattice spacings from database entries for calcite, high-Mg calcite, dolomite and magnesite; these are not new products or measured current unit cells. SI Figure S2 is the source FTIR series at 0, 10, 20, 40 and 100 mM Mg. Its band assignments support calcite versus ACC and water, without turning every listed band into a measured peak for every specimen.

intuition.title: Reported setup and missing duration
intuition.text: Each vessel contains 50 cm3 precursor solution and FTO substrate under a polymer cover with several pinholes. Two vessels share a 750 cm3 desiccator and 4.0 g ammonium carbonate CO2 source at 25 °C. Deposition time, pH, post-treatment, substrate dimensions and pinhole geometry are unreported. The shared carbonate charge is not duplicated into per-vessel charges.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
